description: Angular component for configuring a SCADA symbol widget, including form setup, validation, and output configuration.

classes.name: ScadaSymbolBasicConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component for basic configuration of a SCADA symbol widget, extending BasicWidgetConfigComponent.

methods.name: targetDevice
methods.description: Getter for the target device configuration.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the form group used for widget configuration.

methods.name: onConfigSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided configuration data.

methods.name: prepareOutputConfig
methods.description: Prepares and returns the output widget configuration based on form data.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns list of form fields that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on current form state.

methods.name: getCardButtons
methods.description: Determines which card buttons should be enabled based on widget config.

methods.name: setCardButtons
methods.description: Sets the enableFullscreen property based on selected buttons.
